 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Draw a color-3 horizontal separator through an internal blank row of color-2 objects."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    occupied = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v == 2 for v in row)]
    if not occupied:
        return out
    top, bottom = min(occupied), max(occupied)
    blank_rows = [r for r in range(top + 1, bottom) if not any(v == 2 for v in grid[r])]
    if blank_rows:
        # The separator is the internal empty row separating the two parts.
        r = blank_rows[0]
        out[r] = [3] * len(grid[r])
    return out
"
